curriculum.title: Business Analytics Capstone
points: This capstone project involves advanced data analysis skills through corporate dataset exploration: data acquisition, transformation, exploratory analysis with statistics and visualization, predictive modeling using supervised learning, prescriptive analytics for strategy, and data storytelling for compelling narratives.

content.title: Do I need to have prior Business Analytics experience to enroll in the program?
content: No, the program is designed to be inclusive of all levels of experience. All topics will be covered from the basics, making it suitable for individuals from any field of work.

content.title: What is the minimum system configuration required?
content: Any latest processor (i3/i5/i7) with 2.0GHz clock speed and RAM 4GB (required), 8GB(recommended).

content.title: How many projects can I anticipate working on?
content: In Professional Certificate Program in Business Analytics for Managers you will have access to many case studies from the industries and Capstone Project to provide a better understanding of the real-world applications of Business Analytics concepts.

content.title: What's the difference between case studies & projects?
content: Case studies are targeted towards concept validation and limited to only a single concept. However, projects are targeted to overall learning and are more of a combination of multiple topics.

content.title: What all topics are covered in the Professional Certificate Program in Business Analytics for Managers?
How much time does one need to spend on a regular basis?
content: Typically, students spend around 30 minutes on preparation every day, although this may vary according to their academic needs. Additionally, students are required to attend live classes as scheduled, with the class schedule shared in advance.

content.title: What is the duration of the program?
content: Every term is for 4-5 weeks approximately. The overall Professional Certificate Program in Business Analytics for Managers duration is 6 months.

content.title: How's the Professional Certificate Program in Business Analytics for Managers program different?
content: ## This program is distinguished by three key elements:

- **Iterative Mastery Approach:** IITG's exclusive Iterative Mastery Approach ensures development through a step-by-step methodology, specifically designed to welcome individuals from diverse backgrounds. Whether you're seeking a lateral move in the industry or looking to broaden your skills, our program is tailored to empower you on your unique learning journey.

- **Versatile Skill Development Model:** IITG's unique framework ensures that every Business Analytics concept is taught in the context of real-world industry problems. Our program goes beyond theory, emphasizing practical case studies to prepare students for the challenges they'll face in the professional arena.
- **Accredian Career Center:** Aligned with our mission to cultivate the leaders of tomorrow, the Accredian Career Center empowers you to confidently launch your career.

content.title: Tell me more about Career Assistance?
content: Accredian provides career assistance through the Career Launchpad program. Students gain hands-on experience as leaders in their chosen field with rigorous resume and portfolio building sessions. The program also covers creating a strong online presence and developing top-notch interview skills.
